profile: Meshy juvenile foal; distinct juvenile proportions
status: Candidate-derived juvenile asset for visual, masks, and rig review; not approved production anatomy

source.ownershipBasis: Owner-generated candidate; paid Meshy plan ownership subject to compliant input and privacy settings

idleAnimation.rootMotion: none; Pelvis_Root has no keyed transform
idleAnimation.style: subtle breathing and head settle; torso rotation peak reduced to 0.15 degrees after hoof-support audit; no ear, tail, gait, or graze channels
idleAnimation.loop: exact neutral pose at frame 1 and frame 97; CYCLES modifiers on channels

idleAnimationExport.rootMotion: none; Root and Pelvis_Root tracks are static
idleAnimationExport.exporterBehavior: Blender glTF emits constant rest tracks for otherwise unkeyed bones

localizedSoftening.method: 4-iteration Smooth modifier with barrel-only vertex falloff

pollArtifactSoftening.method: 7-iteration localized Smooth modifier on centered upper poll; ear shells excluded by lateral falloff

sourceTopology.decimator: COLLAPSE 30000 / 427266; source_to_world baked before decimator; no preceding modifiers

sourceHairMap.reviewStatus: Parent independent boundary review accepted as removal/reference ONLY; generated fin/bristles rejected as final juvenile hair
sourceHairMap.method: Independent locked-camera frontmost source-face traces on both sides, front, q3 and top; explicit ear-shell Body exclusions; enclosed hidden crest faces filled; disconnected islands and seam tips removed. No mirror, remesh, caps, or vertex edits.

supplementalCenterlineFinRemoval.method: fixed-source residual central fin patch between measured ear roots; x/z/lateral bounded polygon centroid filter

sourceHairRemoval.capMethod: per-loop center fan with center biased toward lower boundary to avoid raised ridge
sourceHairRemoval.method: guarded source hair faces removed; cut closed by a triangulated Body cap

cutJunctionRegularization.method: all source faces incident to the guarded degree-four cut junction assigned to the removal side

manePartition.method: neck crest plus a closed three-lobed forelock patch conformed to the edited scalp
manePartition.forelockPatch: single scalp-conforming closed mesh with three forward lobes
manePartition.forelockBoundaryProfile: three eased forward points; narrow at temples, widened behind forehead

scalpFit.method: vertical evaluated-Body rays inside measured central crown corridor

tail.method: single short tapered juvenile tuft rooted at centered rear-rump ray hit
tail.status: new authored tail tuft; not adult tail geometry

authoredHairAttachments.method: barycentric Body-surface weight interpolation at hair vertices, followed by a smooth local anatomical-chain blend

bodyWeightInterpolation.method: barycentric interpolation on nearest triangulated Body surface

bodyMasks.UV0: Smart UV Project from Meshy source without source UV
bodyMasks.canonicalUV1: existing importer anatomy helper with geometry-grounded poll/muzzle axis

perCornerBoundaryRepair.method: per-corner mask projection on majority-classified head/limb polygons

canonicalHeadAxis.method: vertical ray on midline at bilateral ear-root midpoint X, direct hit on the post-cap Body crown; muzzle from centered forward-most nose vertices

minimumAxisBasis.formula: adult minimum * juvenile body height / adult reference body height

middleNeck.description: Lateral Body surface at approximate middle-neck station

The candidate Smart Rig was reviewed before this Idle addition; see target proof for the cleaned target. Idle is a restrained candidate clip, not a production motion acceptance.
Compact foal support is not provided by this single juvenile asset.
